The *Valliyattheragāthā* (Thag 2.3) is a short poetic text situated within the *Dukanipāta* (Book of Twos) of the *Theragāthā* in the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. It consists of verses associated with the elder (thera) Valliya [SuttaCentral]. The text has been widely translated in modern collections, with SuttaCentral cataloging nine translations across eight languages, including an English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].
